## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      3 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: May 18, 2026 - Jul 11, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users report reliability problems. This points to quality gaps competitors can exploit.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _JayRoy (Amanda)_, Jun 6, 2026, 1/5: "You want to pay $20 a month for an app that doesn’t work? My app CONSTANTLY crashes. Chats won’t load, or they start to and reload a dozen times. I have to close and reopen the app EVERY SINGLE TIME I send a message. It’s annoying, and I was paying $20 a month for this? The app used to work so well, I don’t know what they did, but this has been happening for a month now. I followed every guide and suggestion to fix it. Nothing."
            2. _iporjj_, May 18, 2026, 1/5: "I used to love this app, it was amazing. But after coming back recently, the subscription system is completely broken. I subscribed to the Plus plan, the Plus badge shows on my profile, but the chat doesn't respond at all! It keeps showing the "Free messages used up" pop-up. I tried everything: waited for hours, created a brand new account and subscribed from inside the app, but the same bug persists. The app completely fails to sync with App Store purchases. Please fix this server bug immediately!"
            3. _NUMBER_1_CHOSO_LOVER🥹_, Jul 11, 2026, 5/5: "I assumed i wouldn’t be too good of an app but after checking it out I can say I runs pretty well, the bots are kinda realistic and make the rp fun, the app isn’t laggy at all and overall it’s really easy to use/set up"
